letter.acknowledgment.subject: We received your application: {application_title}
letter.acknowledgment.body:
Hello {recipient_name},

{funder_name} received **{application_title}** for {opportunity_title} on {application_submittedAt}.

You can follow its status at any time: [View application status]({links_status})

Thank you,
{funder_name}
letter.revisionRequest.subject: Revision requested: {application_title}
letter.revisionRequest.agreedDate: the date agreed with your program officer
letter.decline.subject: An update on your application to {funder_name}
letter.awardAgreement.subject: Award offered: {award_title}
letter.awardAgreement.body:
Hello {recipient_name},

{funder_name} is pleased to offer **{award_amount}** for **{award_title}**.

To accept, review the offer and sign the grant agreement: [Review and sign]({links_award})

The first payment is scheduled once the agreement is signed by both parties.

Congratulations,
{funder_name}
letter.reportReminder.subject: {requirement_title} is due {requirement_dueDate}
letter.reportReminder.body:
Hello {recipient_name},

**{requirement_title}** for {award_title} is due {requirement_dueDate} ({requirement_timing}).

Much of the report is already filled in from your application and earlier reports: [Open the report]({links_requirement})

Thank you,
{funder_name}
